attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (systemd-managed, ports 2379/2380 opened in firewalld), loaded application keys under /app/, simulated the permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 with the same peer URL and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and confirmed it rejoined, caught up via raft, and now serves the original application keys. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-evidence protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart cluster/data health each time.
